key_impacts: Harbor walls were overtopped in Ludington
Damage to shoreline homes and boat docks reported
Water intake pumps were impacted by large water-level change
Water level fluctuations up to 2 m reported along coastline outside the harbor
Harbor gauge recorded water-level fluctuations up to 0.5 m
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan
Harbor walls were overtopped; damage to shoreline homes and boat docks occurred
NWS received reports of 2 m water level fluctuations just outside the harbor
